title.zh: Fed Holds Rates Steady at 3.75%–4.00% in 10–2 Vote, Two Officials Favor Hike
title.en: Fed Holds Rates Steady at 3.75%–4.00% in 10–2 Vote, Two Officials Favor Hike

current_state.zh: The FOMC voted 10–2 to keep the federal funds target range at 3.75%–4.00%, citing strong activity, resilient spending and elevated inflation, with Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissenting in favor of a 25bp hike.
current_state.en: The FOMC voted 10–2 to keep the federal funds target range at 3.75%–4.00%, citing strong activity, resilient spending and elevated inflation, with Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissenting in favor of a 25bp hike.
